name: Book Hot Desk for Multiple Days
goal: Employee books a hot desk for three consecutive days in the office.
constraints: Dates must be consecutive weekdays and desk availability must be checked.

phases.description: User requests to book a hot desk for a range of dates.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot asks for the date range and location.

phases.description: User provides valid date range and office location.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms desk availability for all dates.

phases.description: Bot confirms the booking for the requested days.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot message lists all booked dates and location.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
